test_cases.name: resolves_session_spec_and_states_it
assertions: Uses the spec this session approved without asking and states its path in one line
Does NOT ask the approval question again for a spec approved in this session

test_cases.name: no_spec_suggests_spec
assertions: Does NOT create any ADR file

test_cases.name: asks_approval_once_when_unknown
assertions: Asks once: Has this spec been reviewed and approved?
Stops when the answer is not approved

test_cases.name: invokes_writing_adr_skill
assertions: Invokes the writing-adr skill, or reads .agents/skills/agentic-os/writing-adr/SKILL.md when the runtime cannot find it
Passes the spec as input and lets the skill decide whether any ADR is needed
Treats `No ADR needed` as a valid outcome

test_cases.name: outputs_go_to_adr_dir_and_decisions
test_cases.input: /adr (spec có một quyết định khó đảo ngược)
assertions: Adds a ## Decisions section to the spec listing each outcome

test_cases.name: stops_after_accept_suggests_plan
assertions: Stops once every ADR or the `No ADR needed` line is accepted
Reports the ADR paths and suggests /plan <spec path>
